facts.fact: A National Assembly committee visit found the Department of Information Communication Technology's own Software Development Section develops and tests applications for the Electronic Government Network and its Network Operations Section administers the network; DICT has 74 staff, 75% technical and 90% Seychellois, per its Principal Secretary.

The Department of Information Communication Technology is stated to run the Electronic Government Network and develop applications for use across it by ministries, departments and agencies, and to support their IT operations day to day.

note: Outsourced contracts are mentioned only as managed by DICT, so no outsourced fact.
